answer: Random jury of 9 drawn without replacement at the epoch zenith, each seat weighted by bonded stake. A farmer controlling k% of identities wins a full jury only k^9 of the time — 10% ownership yields 10⁻⁹. Opal-verified attestations bind each seat to one L2 address, so recycled stake across fresh wallets fails. Jade-signed verdicts finalize only at 9/9 honest quorum; the attacker's expected payoff stays below gas cost. Sampling randomness, not identity count, sets the price of capture.
